Trump's Venezuela Deal and its Impact on Gas Prices Questioned

Donald Trump has claimed a deal with Venezuela would lower gas prices, a proposition that has drawn scrutiny. Questions remain about the specifics and potential effectiveness of this agreement, particularly concerning a reported $100 billion figure. Critics have labeled Trump's approach as outdated imperialism and have also alleged he was promoting 'communism' through the deal. The actual impact on global gas prices remains uncertain.
